comment: The maker names no port. A ninth parameter, DIRECTION, is declared at src/controller/Baronial.hpp:10 but is given no widget and is never read, so it has no census position and gets no line. The SUSTAIN LEVEL knob is configured 0.001 to 4.999 with a unit of Volts (src/controller/Baronial.cpp:24) but is used as a 0.01 to 0.99 fraction of the peak (src/controller/Baronial.cpp:42), so both the tooltip unit and the panel's 0 to 5 marking are wrong. The three curve switches choose between a straight line and sinf(x*pi/2) (src/model/Envelope.hpp:141, :171, :212); the panel prints LIN and EXP.
